song_craft: Voice: plain anupAya quatrain (argument in four beats: denial / question+verdict / diagnosis+rule / stance). No ornament — the verse refuses method, so the reading refuses decoration.

lines: Saṃsāra is not, in truth, for body-holders — of bondage, what news?
Bondage never truly is anyone’s — so the liberation-rite is false.
This error-maker: rope-snake-shadow-ghost delusion. Abandon nothing; grasp nothing —
live healthy, staying as you are.
l3.sanskrit_cite: saṃsāraḥ asti na tattvatas tanubhṛtām bandhasya vārtā eva kā bandhaḥ yasya na jātu tasya vitathā | muktasya muktikriyā eṣaḥ mithyāmohakṛt rajjubhujagacchāyāpiśācabhramaḥ mā kiṃcit tyaja mā gṛhāṇa vihara svasthaḥ yathāvasthitaḥ
notes: muktasya muktikriyA both readings live (BOUNDARY); vihara mood open (BOUNDARY)

verses.craft: Denial-question-diagnosis-rule-stance in four breaths; news kept rhetorical (vArtA asks, never answers); heap kept fourfold; prohibitions doubled (abandon/grasp); stance closes on staying (yathAvasthita end-weight).
verses.rejected: (a) ornamenting diction -> killed: anupAya adorned contradicts itself. (b) resolving muktasya/vihara -> killed by BOUNDARY held-open. (c) trimming the heap -> killed: fourfold is the diagnosis.
